BIDEN_DOZE.title: Doze
BIDEN_DOZE.description: Gain this much [gold]Drowsy[/gold]. At [blue]10[/blue] you nod off. Nothing happens while you're [gold]Dark Brandon[/gold].
BIDEN_NOD_OFF.title: Nod Off
BIDEN_NOD_OFF.description: Your turn ends right away. At the start of your next turn you wake up as [gold]Dark Brandon[/gold].
BIDEN_WAKE_UP.title: Wake Up
BIDEN_WAKE_UP.description: Become [gold]Dark Brandon[/gold] now: [gold]Laser Eyes[/gold] fire for your [gold]Drowsy[/gold], then it resets.
BIDEN_LASER_EYES.title: Laser Eyes
BIDEN_LASER_EYES.description: When you wake up, deal damage equal to your [gold]Drowsy[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BIDEN_TANGENT.title: Tangent
BIDEN_TANGENT.description: Only the lit line happens. After you play any other card, it moves to its next line. As [gold]Dark Brandon[/gold], every line happens.
